title: END USER: AI Chip Smuggling Sim
excerpt: Buy AI chips. Spot the fakes. Sell to the boom. Don't get caught. Free in your browser.
content_html:
Everyone wants the chips. Nobody wants to know how. Run a back-room repair shop above an electronics market in a free port. Spot re-marked GPUs, memory lies and fake quantum chips, sell to AI founders, ministers and hedge funds, keep the export agents and the polite lady's friends happy, and pay back the fund. A satire of the AI gold rush, free in your browser.
